title: Abandoned Idaho bridge gets a second life as wildlife crossing
summary_full: An abandoned bridge over Interstate 90 in Osburn, Idaho, was repurposed as a wildlife crossing. This initiative was championed by a local truck driver who witnessed numerous animal collisions. Conservation groups and state officials collaborated to transform the unused structure into a safe passage. Trail cameras confirmed deer regularly using the bridge, avoiding the dangerous interstate. The bridge, though temporary, successfully provided a vital crossing for animals.
